summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Stride Tribe MVP. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests PASSED (100%) covering auth (register/login/me/profile), groups (CRUD + city/category/day filters + cities), membership workflows (public instant-approve, private pending->admin approve, reject, leave, admin-cannot-leave, members list), workouts (list, admin-only create, RSVP going/maybe with count, admin-only cancel, my/calendar), and file upload+serve. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): 8/8 critical UI flows PASSED - login, discover feed with seeded groups, category filter (Trail), group detail navigation, calendar tab with day strip, profile screen with edit/signout, new-user registration + auto-login, and join-public-group flow (button flips from 'Join Group' to 'Leave Group'). Console warnings observed for React Native Web deprecations ('shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents') - non-blocking but should be migrated.

minor.issue: No file size/MIME validation beyond extension whitelist. A very large or non-image payload could still be uploaded. Consider max-size check + magic-byte validation.
Endpoint is fully public (comment acknowledges this) - anyone with a path can fetch any uploaded file. Fine for group cover images but not for future private assets.
Returns 200 with success status even when no membership row matched update (update_one with matched_count==0 is silently OK). Consider verifying matched_count>0 and returning 404 otherwise.

issues: React Native Web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow); 'props.pointerEvents' is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking, but worth resolving to keep console clean.

action_items: (Optional) Add cleanup for TEST_-prefixed data created by backend_test.py in future iterations (fixture teardown) - seeded 'TEST Group ...' entries currently persist in discover feed.
(Optional) Migrate deprecated RN Web style props: replace shadow* with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence console warnings.
(Optional) Enforce membership existence check in approve/reject endpoints (currently silently returns 200 even if no membership row exists).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: seed() correctly guarded by demo-user existence check (idempotent). Good.
server.py: All MongoDB queries use uuid string ids and exclude _id via helper serializers (group_public/workout_public/public_user). No ObjectId leakage.
server.py: Auth flows follow playbook - bcrypt with gensalt, JWT with sub/iat/exp, HTTPBearer dependency. Good.
server.py: create_group makes admin membership row atomically. Good.
server.py: require_admin correctly gates POST/DELETE /workouts and approve/reject.
frontend: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, chips, cards) carry testID props - excellent test coverage surface.
frontend: uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env) - not EXPO_BACKEND_URL. This is Expo's public env convention; harmless but noted.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed users/groups/workouts in MongoDB; these are not auto-cleaned. Demo seed data is created idempotently by backend startup (5 groups, 4 workouts, 1 admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://pace-finder-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - runs against public URL. All endpoints tested with data-persistence GET-verification pattern. Frontend uses testID attributes throughout - use [data-testid='...'] selectors on 390x844 mobile viewport. Discover feed at /, group detail at /group/{id}, workout detail at /workout/{id}, tabs at /calendar /profile /groups (My Groups).
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs to RCA. All requested features validated successfully.
